title: fix: validate expiresIn on device approve
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: POST /api/device/approve now validates expiresIn as a positive integer number of seconds whose expiry fits within the JavaScript Date range, preventing invalid lifetimes from being reported by device token responses. It also type-checks userCode, apiKey and apiKeyId as non-empty strings; expiresIn remains optional or nullable for keys without an expiry, and an empty scope remains valid. Invalid requests receive a 400 ValidationError before a KV entry is written, leaving the device code pending so approval can be retried. Key creation uses the same shared expiry rule without changing its behavior, and POST /api/oauth/code gains the Date-range check. No one-year expiry cap was added.
